dialogue.speaker: lemon-monster
text: RAAAWR! Who dares sing in my pumpkin patch?! I'll carve your blocky skull like a jack-o'-lantern!

dialogue.speaker: djcreeper
text: Uh... a visitor. Is that... lemon?

dialogue.speaker: lemon-monster
text: LEMON MONSTER! The Pumpkin Moon rises... now we PANIC!

dialogue.speaker: djcreeper
text: Sss... then let's make some noise!
